groups.note: What each column DOES in a concept's grounding (source-namespaced — every source defines its own).

terms.meaning: An identity / join column — how a row is identified and how relations join.
A filterable, group-by attribute — you slice and pivot the data by it.
Display-only detail — carried for context, not a key and not aggregated.
An additive numeric fact — the number you sum / average.

groups.note: The kind of behavioural contract a rule expresses (MAC-core, source-agnostic).

terms.meaning: How to resolve / interpret a value — routing, canonicalisation, which column to trust.
How a measure rolls up across an axis (sum / average / not-additive).
The assumption to apply when something isn't specified in the question.
How to handle a genuinely ambiguous case (which reading wins, or refuse).
Rows or values to exclude / filter out of an answer.
An invariant the data is guaranteed to hold — relied on without re-checking.

groups.note: What kind of thing a concept is (MAC-core). Chosen first; drives which blocks are required.

terms.meaning: A real-world thing with its own identity.
Something that happens — a lifecycle with states / phases.
A numeric fact you aggregate (needs an additivity block).
A closed set of coded values — a lookup / code list (needs a values block).
A dimension / lookup that identifies and describes.
A rollup that groups a leaf concept — e.g. region over country (needs a members block).
A meta-plane concept — about the model itself, not the business data.

groups.note: How trustworthy a concept's definition is — the maturity signal on the Ontology Quality dashboard.

terms.meaning: Confirmed by an SME — authoritative.
Inferred by the harvest (machine) — plausible but not SME-confirmed.
Needs SME input — a known open question / gap.

groups.note: How trustworthy a single rule is (a different scale from concept confidence).

terms.meaning: Confirmed — an SME has signed it off.
Proposed — authored from the schema/context, not yet confirmed (the default).
Rejected — kept for the record but NOT active.

groups.note: How a concept's rows are uniquely identified (MAC-core).

terms.meaning: An ISO standard code (e.g. iso2 / iso3 for country).
A plain coded key.
A code namespaced by another dimension (e.g. brand-scoped country code).
Identity via a foreign-key name.
Identity is the composite of several columns (typical for fact / KPI grain).
Identity resolved along an axis at query time.
Identity not yet decided — needs an SME.

groups.note: Per axis, whether a measure can be summed (MAC-core; only these two values exist).

terms.meaning: Can be summed across this axis (e.g. volume over time).
Cannot be summed across this axis (a stock, or unlike KPI types together).

groups.note: The stage a relationship lives at (MAC-core).

terms.meaning: A stored foreign-key join between the relations.
A semantic relationship between concepts (identity / shared_attribute).
A cross-source relationship (same real-world thing across sources).
